new.name: Modulify
new.description: Modulify turns a text prompt into a working website or web app, such as a landing page, marketing site, dashboard, internal tool or clickable prototype, with layouts, copy, images, a CMS, a database, analytics and hosting included, and you can edit anything visually before publishing; it targets founders, marketers, designers, product managers and ops teams, has free templates and paid plans.

new.name: RLinf
new.description: RLinf is an Apache-2.0 reinforcement-learning infrastructure for embodied and agentic AI that scales PPO and GRPO training across GPUs for vision-language-action robot policies and LLM agents, with recent support for OpenPI pi0.5 fine-tuning, GenieSim, SO-101 arms and humanoid simulators; documentation is on Read the Docs.

new.name: Agency Orchestrator
new.description: Agency Orchestrator is an Apache-2.0 multi-agent tool that turns one sentence into a team of AI expert roles, 276 in Chinese and 184 in English, which collaborate through zero-code YAML workflows and deliver a finished plan checked against acceptance criteria, pausing for your sign-off on big decisions; it runs as a local web studio, desktop app or Docker image with about 20 model providers, including ones that reuse a signed-in Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

new.name: Magic Context
new.description: Magic Context is an MIT-licensed memory layer for coding agents, part of CortexKit, that keeps one long-running session per project: it captures what happens, consolidates it into durable memory and recalls the relevant context later, so the agent remembers past decisions instead of starting each task from scratch; it includes a dashboard and configuration docs.

new.name: Paperasse
new.description: Paperasse is an MIT-licensed collection of Agent Skills, in French, that turn Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents into copilots for French business paperwork: bookkeeping and VAT, year-end closing and tax returns, 2026 e-invoicing rules, tax audits, personal income tax and wealth tax, notarial law for property and inheritance, and condominium management, with references to the French tax and civil codes.

new.name: Aaron Marketing Skills
new.description: Aaron Marketing Skills is an Apache-2.0 pack of 120 marketing Agent Skills across seven disciplines, narrative, SEO and GEO, social, email, paid ads, influencer and launch, installable as one plugin, as portable skills on many agent hosts or as an eight-bot team, with auditor gates that score content quality and campaign readiness; skills are plain Markdown with small Bash and Python runtimes.

new.name: Finance Skills
new.description: Finance Skills is an MIT-licensed collection of Agent Skills for financial analysis and trading research, installable as Codex plugin groups or with npx skills for other agents, and grouped into market analysis and data-provider packs, some with bundled MCP servers; documentation and demos are at skills.himself65.com, and the README stresses it is for education, not financial advice.

new.name: HiThink Finance (Tonghuashun Financial Data)
new.description: HiThink Finance is the official Tonghuashun (10jqka) financial data service for China's A-share market, aimed at AI agents and quant research: one API key gives real-time and historical quotes, call auctions, financial statements, valuations, indices, sectors, funds and IPO data through a REST API, a hosted MCP server, a CLI with built-in agent skills, a Python SDK or a local DuckDB store. The client code is MIT-licensed; the data needs an API key.

stars.name: REA
stars.description: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents reverse engineer native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies and live websites, using Ghidra, Hopper or IDA under the hood.

stars.name: OpenClaw
stars.description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in the chat apps you already use, including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp, with native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, models and harnesses such as Claude, Codex or local models are swappable plugins, and one gateway can run a personal or shared multiplayer assistant. It is stewarded by the non-profit OpenClaw Foundation with no paid tier or hosted service.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only for the model providers you connect.

stars.name: ECC
stars.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond

stars.name: DeepSeek Harness
stars.description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness with a local web UI, built so that every tool, model and scheduled task is a swappable plugin; still a developer preview.

stars.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
stars.description: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's MIT-licensed, self-improving agent with a built-in learning loop: it writes skills from completed tasks, refines them in use, keeps agent-curated memory and searches its own past conversations. It runs on anything from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure, offers a full terminal UI, and one gateway serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI, with any model via Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); model usage billed by your chosen provider.

stars.name: opencode
stars.description: OpenCode is an MIT-licensed open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with many model providers instead of locking you to one. Install it with a one-line script, npm, Homebrew, pacman, mise or Nix, then let it read your repository, edit files and run commands from a keyboard-driven TUI.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); bring your own model provider.

stars.name: n8n
stars.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-host or cloud.

stars.name: Firecrawl
stars.description: Turns websites into clean, LLM-ready data for agents.
